text:
Rachelle Tran: Heads-up: legal wants an opt-out for telemetry in the marketplace SDK change. We're also moving to a new auth header format. Propose a 9-week runway with server-side per-partner enforcement flags.

Diego Marrero: OK. For auth: support both headers during grace: legacy `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and new `Authorization: Redwood v2 <token>`. After enforcement, only v2 allowed.

Hannah Wu: I'll draft the marketplace banner + a short FAQ explaining "Telemetry optional" and the opt-out endpoint. Also will add a note about on-prem agent compatibility.

Diego Marrero: I'll publish shims for python/js and a migration guide. Plan: SDK beta in week 2, partner canaries weeks 3-5, wider canary week 7, enforcement week 9.

Rachelle Tran: partner-bot, create JIRA. Also need a list of top 12 marketplace sellers and two SIs for direct outreach.

partner-bot: New JIRA PARTNER-10011 "SDK auth v2 + telemetry opt-out: marketplace rollout" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PARTNER-10011

Hannah Wu: Will schedule office hours during week 3 and send calendar invites.

Diego Marrero: Quick doc snippet for partners: curl -H "Authorization: Redwood v2 TOKEN" -H "X-RW-Telemetry-Version: 2" https://api.redwood.ai/telemetry

Rachelle Tran: Great. Actions: Hannah -> comms + office hours, Diego -> shims + migration guide, Rachelle -> partner exec outreach + JIRA. Add blockers now.
